{"metadata":{"description":"DSH ZCode UI — 把 DeepSeek Harness Web 的界面换成 ZCode 风格：侧栏、工作区会话树、全局搜索与轮次导航。A ZCode-styled sidebar, workspace session tree, global search, and turn navigation skin for DSH Web.","id":"gh:1415380521","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-zcode-ui","slug":"jungenius-stack/dsh-zcode-ui","topics":["deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","sidebar","theme","ui","zcode"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH ZCode UI — 把 DeepSeek Harness Web 的界面换成 ZCode 风格：侧栏、工作区会话树、全局搜索与轮次导航。A ZCode-styled sidebar, wor"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"kspace session tree, global search, and turn navigation skin for DSH Web."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH ZCode UI"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**A ZCode-style visual skin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web — sidebar, workspace session tree, global"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" search, turn navigation**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"简体中文 · Changelog · Apache-2.0"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> [!IMPORTANT]
> **This is a personal, community-maintained project. It carries no official endorsem"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ent.**
> It is **not** a DeepSeek AI product, and it is **not** an official plugin of any kind — it "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"is maintained by one individual (`jungenius-stack`) in their own time.
> It is a fork of the open-so"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"urce project MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui (Apache-2.0), and its design values are taken from zai-org/ZCode"},{"id":"p5s5","text":" (Apache-2.0).
> "DeepSeek", "DeepSeek Harness" and "ZCode" are the property of their respective own"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"ers; the names are used here only to describe compatibility and design provenance."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Every pixel, measured. Every motion, earned."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Most skins eyeball a screenshot and start copying. We didn't."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"**dsh-zcode-ui** is the result of a six-week design-inheritance program in which nothing — not a
sin"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"gle radius, not a single frame of easing — was guessed. We opened ZCode itself with the Chrome
DevTo"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ols Protocol and read its computed styles live. We unpacked its startup page and lifted the
keyframe"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"s verbatim. We sampled its dialog shadows pixel by pixel. Then we rebuilt that language
inside DeepS"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"eek Harness — 14,480 lines of TypeScript, 85+ modules, one design system."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The result doesn't imitate ZCode. It **speaks ZCode, natively, inside another app**."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"And it stays fast doing it: sidebar collapse runs a single 300ms glide with **zero long tasks**,
the"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" composer sits flat and still under your cursor, and a cinematic splash — your app icon popping
to l"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ife over macOS vibrancy — welcomes you at launch, gone in under a second."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**Measured, not estimated. Guarded, not hoped for.** That is the whole philosophy — and it's why
thi"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"s skin feels less like a theme and more like the interface DeepSeek Harness was meant to have."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"> [!NOTE]
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Not a theme file. A full design system, inherited at the token layer — every official surface
recolo"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"rs as one piece, in both light and dark:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Area | What the skin does |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| **Layout** | ZCode sidebar geometry — 8px radii, 32px rows, `px-2 / py-3 / gap-1` spacing, 150–200"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ms `ease-out` motion, seven-step type scale |
| **Colour** | Full Zai Light / Zai Dark palettes writ"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ten into DSH's `--dsw-*` token layer; official regions (title bar, session list, buttons, menus, com"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"poser shell) recolour as one piece |
| **Icons** | Lucide (the same icon library ZCode uses) for sid"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"ebar navigation and row actions |
| **Theme** | Follows the host's own light/dark preference via `bo"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"dy[data-ds-dark-theme]`; light canvas `#f8f8f8`, dark canvas `#161616` |
| **Sidebar behaviour** | P"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"in / group / drag-reorder projects and conversations, unread and running indicators, header search o"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"ver sessions + settings + quick actions, rename / archive / fork / copy / delete, turn navigation in"},{"id":"p16s9","text":" long conversations, Up/Down recall of previous input |
| **Conversation craft** | 784px text column"},{"id":"p16s10","text":", 20px turn rhythm, 0.35px tracking, right-aligned user bubbles with collapse, ZCode-grade tables an"},{"id":"p16s11","text":"d blockquotes, fenced code cards, no horizontal scroll |
| **Motion** | Intent-tiered tokens (enter "},{"id":"p16s12","text":"/ feedback / move / press), sidebar collapse in one 300ms glide with **zero long tasks**, shared ent"},{"id":"p16s13","text":"rance animations so nothing appears out of sync |
| **Startup** | A cinematic splash — your app icon"},{"id":"p16s14","text":" popping to life over macOS vibrancy, gone in under a second, with a 3-second failsafe so it can nev"},{"id":"p16s15","text":"er trap you |
| **Dialog grammar** | One family as the single default, scored 8/9 in an independent "},{"id":"p16s16","text":"design review; the heavyweight family reserved for blocking confirmations — and the two never mix |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- A working **DeepSeek Harness Web** installation with `dsh` on your `PATH`. Examples below use the "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"`web` profile; substitute your own profile name.
- **Host compatibility.** Peer dependencies declare"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*` range `>=0.1.6-alpha.2 <0.3.0-0`; development is pinned to `0.2.0-r"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"c.2`. The heavy gate (`pnpm gate:host`) packs the plugin, installs it into an isolated `DSH_HOME`, a"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"nd exercises the real `dsh` binary found on the machine — override it with `DCU_DSH_BIN`.
- **Node.j"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"s `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`** if you build from source.
- ⚠️ On macOS, do **not** put DSH's bundled Nod"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"e 24 first on `PATH` when building or testing: it cannot load the `rolldown` native binding (`code s"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"ignature ... different Team IDs`) and `vitest` / `tsdown` will fail. Any other Node 22.22.x works."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Recorded honestly in `docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md` — the file is the source of truth, and everything below "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"in `docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md` — the file is the source of truth, and everything below is expanded there:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- **Three assertions are skipped on purpose.** They validate the upstream monorepo's release contrac"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ts (`packages/`, `.github/workflows/`), which do not exist in this single-package fork. The files ar"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"e kept with an explicit `SKIP` block rather than deleted, so "test missing" and "problem solved" sta"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"y distinguishable.
- **Compatibility boundary: built on 0.2.0-rc.2, run daily on 0.2.1-rc.2.** `engi"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"nes.dsh` and the 11 peers all start at `>=0.2.0-rc.2`, because `devDependencies` are pinned there an"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"d this repo has never compiled against an earlier host. The upper bound stays `<0.3.0-0` on purpose:"},{"id":"p21s7","text":" the author uses the plugin on 0.2.1-rc.2 every day, and narrowing it would lock real users out thro"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"ugh the DSH version gate — but 0.2.1 has not entered the build or the gate. That difference is state"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"d here rather than hidden inside a range that looks generous.
- **Four of the seven interface issues"},{"id":"p21s10","text":" reported from real use are not this plugin's.** They were traced to the cost-meter and context-pilo"},{"id":"p21s11","text":"t plugins (duplicate cost display, cramped status bar) and to a host-built-in control; they are docu"},{"id":"p21s12","text":"mented, not silently ignored.
- **Two upstream issues (#40, #41) were probed and did not reproduce**"},{"id":"p21s13","text":" at four window sizes on macOS. Neither is still open: upstream closed both as `completed` on 2026-1"},{"id":"p21s14","text":"0-13 (re-checked 2026-10-18). Non-macOS platforms, real display scaling, and full-screen/split-scree"},{"id":"p21s15","text":"n remain untested.
